offer.text:
THIEF!
A gull takes your purse

A trained grey gull snags a bag containing ¤1,000. Its tether catches your wrist. You can grab the bag, but the skiff is drifting toward the stone quay.

Reach for the bag
70% chance to keep it. On failure, lose ¤1,000 and 10% hull (you have 100%).
Let the bag go · ¤1,000
Certain cash loss. Your hull and cargo stay safe.
